dedupe_keys.name: integrated fault detection and supervisory compensation for hydronic radiator faults in district heated buildings

description: Nima Monghasemi and colleagues publish code for detecting and compensating hydronic-heating faults inside EnergyPlus through its Python API. The August 2026 archive provides trained one-class SVM, isolation-forest and local-outlier-factor detectors, model inputs and derived results, free under MIT terms for author code. Coverage is a representative DOE retail building using district heating and Västerås weather, with ten-minute simulations over October–April. Scenarios include restricted valve flow, thermostat over-delivery bias and supply-temperature bias. These materials can benchmark fault diagnosis and supervisory-control simulations; thermostat bias is a proxy for over-delivery, not a demonstrated valve mechanism. Related catalogue record model-energyplus is required at version 25.1.0. Training uses fault-free data, runtime logs must be regenerated, and stored detectors depend on the pinned scikit-learn version. Generalisation and uncertainty remain unverified. The manuscript is described as submitted, and no code was executed.
